svg.text: Riley: a hollow brass retro PC
Artist's impression, drawn from the frame template's real measurements · About 19 cm tall · 14 cm wide · 10 cm deep
camera: sees you, looks when asked
2.8" touch screen in its own ring
tilt servo turns the head axle
swivel foot on a turntable bearing
No panels: every part and wire is on show, so keep the wiring neat (braided sleeving, cable ties, nylon standoffs).
